subject.title: fix(agy): suppress tool use and file links in print-mode summaries

question: Should Antigravity text-only calls trade a small amount of maximum prompt capacity for cleaner no-tools summary output?
rationale: Antigravity exposes no native no-tools print flag, so the prompt suffix is the narrow available mitigation but necessarily counts against the argv limit.

options.title: Accept the bounded tradeoff
options.body: Merge the focused mitigation because it prevents contaminated summaries and only slightly reduces the largest accepted Antigravity text-only prompt.

options.title: Wait for upstream support
options.body: Keep current behavior until Antigravity provides a native no-tools print-mode switch that does not consume argv capacity.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded tradeoff
recommendation.body: Merge the focused mitigation because it prevents contaminated summaries and only slightly reduces the largest accepted Antigravity text-only prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is best placed to accept this provider-specific compatibility tradeoff.
